closed_hostile_findings: record-count-only checkpoint scheduling could deadlock on a retained byte tail; a bounded age trigger now checkpoints any advanced frontier, and a 9-byte retained tail plus a 2-byte retry under a 10-byte limit converges after process replacement

bootstrap anchoring could churn zero-delta checkpoints because one live completed checkpoint always remains; exact durable participant retirement anchors now suppress idle churn and the open-source regression proves the checkpoint ordinal remains stable across many polls
the maintenance process retained every checkpoint ID in an unbounded set; it now keeps one latest retired checkpoint ID while PostgreSQL remains the durable retry authority

maintenance process loss at an injected barrier or after checkpoint completion could strand control/retention work; fresh execution attempts resume the pending checkpoint or completed retention gap and converge through independent oracles

a hard-coded passthrough task could not execute a declared graph; immutable per-participant artifacts and code digests now run a real RETURN filter and uppercase transform and reject graph/code drift before DATA

attempt replacement or stale source/operator actors could publish after takeover; durable attempt, source-capability and operator-binding fences reject old actors while same-flow task retry rebinds only the failed participant

telemetry compared a committed writer epoch with a concurrently renewed lease and could fail execution; terminal coordinates now come only from committed turn/receipt rows and a missing observation emits a bounded diagnostic without becoming progress authority
the real browser test left profile writers racing teardown; graceful CDP Browser.close, isolated process-group cleanup and bounded exact directory cleanup pass three consecutive real Chromium runs
explicit_limits: the selected adapter profile is one structured source partition feeding a fully bootstrapped native join DAG with asynchronous nonblocking source iteration
regional recovery remains supported by R3 standalone, but starting it while a Prefect execution attempt is ACTIVE is rejected atomically; the two ownership protocols are not composed in this gate

arbitrary output byte amplification is not predicted; unsafe fan-in capacity is rejected before DATA, while a single oversized source document is a permanent named input error and oversized operator output fails and fences the flow
a caught terminal adapter exception closes the logical run; same-run execution replacement is supported only while the durable lifecycle remains ACTIVE after infrastructure/process loss
direct database credentials and protocol schema provisioning remain trusted until DS-051c
telemetry storage is bounded in-process evidence rather than a production durable tracing backend, and native Prefect history has its own later retention policy
upgrade compatibility, schema backup/restore, infrastructure chaos, worker credential isolation and the 72-hour soak remain R5 gates
logical row/JSON-byte census excludes PostgreSQL heap, indexes, WAL and vacuum amplification
phase: R4-B independent ETL Architect / HighLoad Principal gate review

DS-041a.basis: feature-flagged actual Prefect 3 flow and long-lived per-node/source tasks stream documents immediately through immutable operator artifacts, durable R3 authority and public Prefect states without per-document task runs or persisted secrets

DS-041b.basis: durable bounded execution attempts, source capabilities and participant bindings survive API/controller restart, isolate participant retry, fence whole-infrastructure replacement and resume the first incomplete document plus pending maintenance state

DS-041c.basis: independent PostgreSQL projection/oracle, real Prefect API states, W3C trace correlation and committed terminal coordinates expose lag, exact in-flight owner/input, completion, barrier and recovery causes without payload/token leakage

DS-041d.basis: authenticated HTTP metrics/dashboard, real Chromium mobile/drain/auth checks, alert/runbook drills, bounded maintenance across hard capacity and two 100-cycle logical-storage censuses pass under the frozen remote_apply profile
